history.summary: IDENTITY NOTE: this is the Kaila Devi Mandir on Kaila Devi Road, Ram Nagar Extension / Mishrilal Nagar, Dewas (MP), a local neighbourhood Hindu temple about 1 km from Dewas railway station — NOT the famous Kaila Devi temple of Karauli, Rajasthan. No web sources (beyond map/directory listings) document its history, founding date, builders or architectural style; the entry is based on business-directory records (rated ~4.6/5 from several hundred reviews). Directory listings associate a 51-ft Lord Hanuman statue with the temple premises (verify). Researching local or Hindi-language sources is recommended before treating any detail as settled.

name: Kaila Devi Mandir
town_description: Dewas is a historic industrial city in western Madhya Pradesh, about 35 km northeast of Indore on the Malwa plateau. Its identity is dominated by the Tekri, a 300-ft hill in the middle of the city crowned by the two sister-goddess temples, and it was the seat of two princely states (Dewas Senior and Junior) under the Puars and Marathas. Devotees also pass through Dewas on Indore–Ujjain–Omkareshwar pilgrimage circuits.
